proposed_widenings.name: modify_damage_type
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has an always-on weapon rider that lets each hit from this specific weapon deal Lightning damage instead of its normal Piercing damage. The current surface can scope a passive rider to a specific item, but it cannot substitute a weapon attack's damage type without inventing a false numeric or direct-damage effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

notes: Do not author content for this unit. The Lightning Bolt property itself could fit an activated magic-item part using replace_attack, a fixed DC 13 save_gate over a 5-foot-wide line, return-to-hand as a currently unmodeled secondary lifecycle detail, and a once-per-dawn reset. The item still fails honest encoding because its baseline on-hit damage-type substitution lacks a v4/surface atom.
